It works on CD (Cold Diffusion) technology, made to suit Indian climatic conditions, and its in-cap fragrance flow regulator lets you set how much fragrance flows into the car. IFRA (International Fragrance Association) compliant. A Ripple Fragrances product from the house of Cycle Pure Agarbathies.
details.manufacturerName: Ripple Division, N. Ranga Rao & Sons Pvt. Ltd., #1553 Vanivilasa Road, Mysuru 570004, Karnataka
details.usageInstructions: Place the gel on the dashboard or any flat surface in the car. Turn the cap to set how much fragrance it releases. Lasts up to 60 days.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Keep away from children and pets. Avoid contact with eyes, skin and car upholstery; if the liquid spills, wipe it off at once. Do not swallow.

details.description: Lia room freshener makes your home an abode of calm and joy. The long-lasting can removes odours and fills the room with an enticing Agarwood fragrance, with a spray-through cap for ease and safety. Self-blended in India for Indian climates, it gives a minimum of 500 sprays of two to three seconds each and meets IFRA (International Fragrance Association) standards. From the house of Cycle Pure Agarbathies.
details.manufacturerName: Ripple Division, N. Ranga Rao & Sons Pvt. Ltd., #1553 Vanivilasa Road, Mysuru 570004, Karnataka
details.usageInstructions: Close all windows and doors of the room. Shake well before use. Hold the can upright and spray 8 to 10 jets (about 6 seconds each) in all directions towards the ceiling. Repeat as and when required.
details.dangerWarnings: Extremely flammable. Do not pierce or burn, even after use. Protect from heat and sunlight and do not expose to temperatures above 50°C. Keep away from eyes and do not inhale when spraying. Keep out of reach of children.
